items.title: Sunflower Seedling Tray
items.alt: Six-cell fiber nursery tray with small sunflower seedlings and one plain wooden marker.
items.description: Six-cell fiber nursery tray with small sunflower seedlings and one plain wooden marker. The varied seedlings suit a classroom growing observation or a personal sowing checklist.

items.title: Sunflower Foil Balloon
items.alt: Golden sunflower-shaped foil balloon with a textured dark center, curled blue ribbon and small gold weight.
items.description: Golden sunflower-shaped foil balloon with a textured dark center, curled blue ribbon and small gold weight. Use the complete party decoration in a personal celebration invitation or a classroom materials comparison.

items.title: Children Watering Sunflowers
items.alt: Black-and-white children beside a sunflower bed, one pouring a watering can while the other watches.
items.description: Black-and-white children beside a sunflower bed, one pouring a watering can while the other watches. Color their different outfits and use the scene in a classroom plant-care activity.

items.title: Sunflower Garden Fence
items.alt: Black-and-white sunflowers behind a short picket fence with a small pot and curved stepping stones.
items.description: Black-and-white sunflowers behind a short picket fence with a small pot and curved stepping stones. The bounded garden suits a classroom coloring page or a personal summer scene.

items.title: Making a Sunflower Crown
items.alt: Black-and-white seated young adult making a sunflower crown at a table with loose flowers and thread.
items.description: Black-and-white seated young adult making a sunflower crown at a table with loose flowers and thread. Use the complete craft scene in a classroom coloring activity or a personal craft journal.

items.title: Sunflower Growth Sequence
items.alt: Black-and-white row of four pots showing sunflower growth from a germinating seed to a flowering plant with roots visible.
items.description: Black-and-white row of four pots showing sunflower growth from a germinating seed to a flowering plant with roots visible. Use the separate stages in a classroom sequencing activity and add your own observations beside them.
